### Steam prices. Right where you need them.

## Compare before you buy. Without leaving Steam.

Stan brings a focused price comparison into the Steam experience itself. When a reliable comparison is available, it appears next to the price you are already viewing. No separate comparison tab. No Stan account required.

The browser extension is intentionally narrow in scope and its browser-side source is published for inspection alongside the package fingerprint and a verified GitHub Release ZIP.

## Public projects

### Stan browser extension

The public extension repository is both the product homepage on GitHub and the inspection/download surface for the current browser package.

**https://github.com/stan-key/extension-source**

If Google services are unavailable, use the current verified package from:

**https://github.com/stan-key/extension-source/releases/latest**
